profile.headline: Sr Software Developer
profile.summary: I've been a Software Developer/Engineer/Consultant in the DMV (District,MD,VA) area for over 20 years.  I've worked on projects for both commercial and federal gov't clients throughout my career.  I find it very rewarding in presenting my projects to the most non-advanced technical users to the most technical.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
•	Software Developer for a Defense Info System Agency (DISA) contract full stack developed software for MacBook and iPad using Ruby, Postgres, JavaScript and Swift in IOS Mac operating system.
•	Peer reviewed code and performed system integrated testing.
•	Attended daily and weekly agile meetings for status and requirements.
•	Documented status reports to project managers.
positions.insights: Skills: Ruby on Rails · Mac · Agile Methodologies · Software Development

positions.title: Software Consultant/Developer
positions.description:
•	Independent subcontracting to Koncepts using ASP, C#.Net, JavaScript and Sql Server for commercial applications.
•	Converted Cobol to ASP C# for Fairfax County Government Property Taxes Division.

positions.title: Software Developer/Business Analyst/Project Manager
positions.description:
Worked with clients to define their needs, address issues and facilitated resolution strategies.
Provided full life-cycle support of analysis, design and development and testing of NIH/CIT Inventory and Billing System intranet web application using Visual Studio ASP.Net, SqlServer, Telerik Controls, KendoUI and Telerik Reporting and API.
Engaged in all security related monitoring, correcting and leadership for the team.
Familiarized with emerging technologies and software development for best practices.
Monitored the status of reported issues to ensure the resolution times are within expected parameters.
Prepared project documentation including status reports, user manuals,  management briefing reports and meeting agendas.

positions.title: Sr Software Developer
positions.description:
Developed Veteran Administration’s Office of Inspector General system in a rapid deployment agile team.
Developed in ASP, C#.Net, JavaScript and Sql Server backend.
Documented user work scheduling Team Foundation Server (TFS) and GIT

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
Software Developer (Independent) for Commercial, Chicago IL
Full life cycle development for Ruby on Rails web applications.
Collaborated with clients to establish and refine requirements
Rapidly prototyped and refined applications based on user experience feedback
Created client-side experiences using technologies like Ruby on Rails and JavaScript
Used common SQL data layers like PostgreSQL and MySQL.
Supported and maintained ASP.Net, MVC, Angular incorporated with C#
Demonstrated understanding of software design patterns, data structures and algorithms, runtime analysis, and performance tuning.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Independent subcontracting to Koncepts using ASP, C#.Net, JavaScript and Sql Server for commercial applications.
•	Converted Cobol to ASP C# for Fairfax County Government Property Taxes Division.
positions.insights: Skills: SQL · ASP.NET · Software Development · C#

positions.title: Applications Developer
positions.description:
Developed a CIA  agency-wide enterprise human resource web application in an agile environment with a team of developers having TS/SCI/FS Poly security standards.
Identified and researched the scope of functionality and suggest development solutions with cost benefit and design options with customer.
Incorporated embedded COTS doing necessary security required checks per standards.
Conducted formal and informal product functional testing throughout the software SDLC to identify functional, performance and schedules potential issues.
Developed backend database design and maintenance Oracle server environment.
Conducted advanced research and recommended innovations.
Developed software using C#.Net, Ajax, ASP.Net, JavaScript, Telerik KendoUI. Telerik Reports and other embedded GOTS/COTS/API tools.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained web application of architect and construction maintenance review board supporting National Security Agency (NSA). 
Developed and maintained software using Microsoft ASP.Net C#.Net VB.Net, ASP, JavaScript with SQLServer database.
Performed cross-team peer review code and testing.

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
Served on a project with a team responsible for the engineering of a cross-collaborative Dept of Defense cybersecurity tool.  
Developed the user interface and backend database for near real-time identification of malicious traffic for the protection and management of IP networks.  
Application developed in Ruby on Rails JavaScript on Linux with MongoDB, MySql interfacing with Netezza data warehouse and other COTS tools.
Tested and recommended COTS tools for embedded engineering.
Developed visual and graphic analytics using Splunk (certification), Tableau, Snort, Google Maps, Netezza, Pentaho
Recorded progress in Agile scheduling tool Jira.

positions.title: Sr. Consultant
positions.description:
Subject Matter Expert full life cycle development and maintenance of projects for clients.
Developed web applications in VB.Net and ASP C#.Net with SqlServer database for a federal defense agency.
Gathered and documented customer requirements and offered solutions to the System Certification Board of NSA.
Evaluated estimated and performed application development and business process change requests under the direction of the appropriate technical leaders and stakeholders. 
Reverse engineered applications and packets using IDA Pro to support defense systems.

positions.title: Sr. Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Served as a project SME at Verizon Information Systems.  Migrated Verizon’s Yellow Pages system from a COBOL  mainframe to a MicroSoft client server environment.   
Designed and administrated databases in Oracle 8i.
Documented system functional, testing and technical specifications.

positions.title: Programmer/Analyst
positions.description:
Developed budget applications in Visual Basic, SQL,Coldfusion and Crystal Reports client server environment. 
Documented requirements, technical specifications, testing and training manuals.  Provided 24-hour customer and operations support for Sprint’s  global telecommunication system.

volunteerExperiences.description: Volunteer in my church ministry distributing food boxes weekly at neighborhood spots.  I also visit nursing homes monthly to engage with seniors in prayers, singing scripture and games.
